architecture_flow: sender Fragment::export_packed leases and packs into sender arena
sender requests a receiver arena lease over PRPC
NIXL WRITE copies sender lease to receiver lease
sender sends metadata, sequence, and EOS over transmit_packed
receiver claims sequence, copies fresh payload into InboundStore pool memory, and releases receiver lease
receiver dispatches only after every sender EOS; Fragment::push_inbound consumes tickets
invariants: leases are aligned, contiguous, and coalesced on release
sender releases source lease only after WRITE completion or send failure
receiver claims sequence before touching replayable payload offset
ticketed inbound data is released by ticket; legacy data by arena lease
receiver readiness requires EOS from every sender

memory_domains.host_disk: available for normal downgrade but checked-tree inbound tickets are not registered as downgrade candidates
memory_domains.mig: one CN per visible device; CUDA device 0 is the process-local registered NIXL device
memory_domains.pool: inbound table after copy-out; normal GPU pool accounting, but no ingress admission/spill in checked tree
memory_domains.staging: stable cudaMalloc/VMM device slab outside RMM and cuCascade accounting

review_findings.impact: Receiver arena capacity can be lost permanently; cancellation cannot discover a never-announced lease.
review_findings.recommended_fix: Idempotent remote lease-abort keyed by lease identity; invoke it on every post-grant failure and fault-injection-test timeout cleanup.
review_findings.title: Remote lease leaks when WRITE fails after grant

review_findings.impact: The EOS barrier permits retained inbound frames to exhaust the normal pool before receiver execution; this is a workload-dependent production-readiness limit.
review_findings.recommended_fix: Treat 91c0370f and 222b646a as separate performance-tree candidate designs, not accepted fixes. Rebase, independently review, and validate bounded progress, cancellation, and correctness before adoption.
review_findings.title: Copy-out is an unadmitted GPU-pool capacity gate

review_findings.impact: A stage that copied the raw memory-space pointer before close can use it while the Context is destructing.
review_findings.recommended_fix: Track active stages through close or retain an owning lifetime guard; add concurrent teardown coverage.
review_findings.title: Inbound staging can race Context teardown

review_findings.impact: Documented launch mode currently fails on the target engine.
review_findings.recommended_fix: Reject/label UUID mode until engine support exists; document ordinal workaround.
review_findings.title: MIG UUID launcher conflicts with recorded engine behavior

review_findings.impact: Cross-host transport support is opt-in without in-tree MNNVL/IMEX validation.
review_findings.recommended_fix: Two-host integration test for mapping, transfer correctness, teardown, and partial bring-up failure.
review_findings.title: Fabric allocation is not integration-tested
